metadata.description: NBA-0 Measure First: walk-forward evaluation of SERVED win probability (norm.cdf(margin/sigma)) and Elo baseline on 2019-20 through 2024-25 regular season games.
metadata.data_source: frozen history: data/history/nba_history.json.gz (regular season only, no playoffs)
metadata.walkforward_method: expanding window, date-based splits, causality enforced (train_max_date < test_min_date)

leak_free_verification.features_causal: build_training_frame uses shift-1 rolling features; compute_h_features emits features BEFORE folding game result into state
leak_free_verification.total_drift_correction: compute_total_drift is ONLY applied at retrain time on full training frame; NOT applied during walk-forward evaluation (walk-forward uses raw model predictions)
leak_free_verification.early_season_blending: shrunk_projections uses only completed_rows (past games) for shrinkage; never sees future games
leak_free_verification.model_refit_per_window: walk_forward_metrics/regression re-fit model_factory on each window's training data only; no shared state across windows
leak_free_verification.sigma_source: margin_sigma = first-window-only training MAE * MAE_TO_SIGMA. Zero leakage: sigma fitted only on games before first scored window (sigma=13.621). Served metrics unchanged (log_loss=0.6224, AUC=0.7027).

metadata.note_on_n_discrepancy: The deep-dive audit cited n=8,388 for 2019-2025; this run uses frozen history through 2025-04-13 (end of 2024-25 regular season), giving 7,308 raw games. The 8,388 may include playoffs or partial 2025-26 season not in frozen history.
